summary: Introduces fragment-first release notes: unreleased/ fragments aggregated into vX.Y.Z/ directories on cut.
migration_impact: Release notes now follow a fragment-first model. Authors commit .json fragments to .agentic/releases/unreleased/ during feature work. At release time, scripts/cut_release.py (or gh plate release cut) aggregates them into .agentic/releases/vX.Y.Z/. Legacy flat vX.Y.Z.json files remain supported.
migration_guidance: 2. Copy scripts/cut_release.py from plate into your repo's scripts/ directory.
3. Copy .agentic/releases/unreleased/README.md to document the contract for contributors.
5. Update scripts/render_release_notes.py and render_release_migrations.py to use the new iter_release_files/load_release_files that handles vX.Y.Z/ dirs.
6. For new Feature PRs: author a fragment in unreleased/ instead of editing a flat version file.
7. Legacy flat files (v0.1.x.json) continue to render correctly — no migration needed for existing records.
agent_notes: Always create a fragment in .agentic/releases/unreleased/ when implementing a Feature that changes PLATE process, templates, or agent surfaces. Name the file <slug>.json. Run scripts/cut_release.py --dry-run to preview the next release cut.
